    def construct(self):
        square = Square()

        def homotopy(x, y, z, t):
            if t <= 0.25:
                progress = t / 0.25
                return (x, y + progress * 0.2 * np.sin(x), z)
            else:
                wave_progress = (t - 0.25) / 0.75
                return (x, y + 0.2 * np.sin(x + 10 * wave_progress), z)

A Homotopy.

This is an animation transforming the points of a mobject according
to the specified transformation function. With the parameter\(t\)moving from 0 to 1 throughout the animation and\((x, y, z)\)describing the coordinates of the point of a mobject,
the function passed to thehomotopykeyword argument should
transform the tuple\((x, y, z, t)\)to\((x', y', z')\),
the coordinates the original point is transformed to at time\(t\).
